---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for APEX
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## What problem does this solve?
A clear description of the problem or limitation you're hitting. Why does this matter?

## Proposed solution
What would you like APEX to do? Describe the feature as if you were writing the spec.

## Alternatives considered
Other approaches you thought about and why they're worse.

## Who benefits?
Which kinds of users would benefit from this? (e.g., career changers, healthcare workers, technical roles, etc.)

## Implementation notes (optional)
If you have ideas about how this could be built, share them. Don't worry about being exhaustive.

## Mockups / examples (optional)
If you've seen a similar feature elsewhere, link to it. Sketches, screenshots, or descriptions all help.
